Premium Safety Protocol

Celebrate With
Care & Joy

A truly grand celebration is a safe one. Adhere to our guidelines to ensure your festival remains spectacular and joyful.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

Adult Supervision

Children must always be supervised by adults while lighting any firework. This is the golden rule.

📏

Keep Distance

Always maintain a safe distance of at least 5 meters. Never bend over a cracker while lighting it.

🕯️

Use Long Sticks

Use a long sparkler or agarbatti to light crackers. Never use matchsticks or pocket lighters.

🌳

Open Spaces Only

Strictly light fireworks in open grounds or terraces. Never light them inside the house or near vehicles.

👕

Wear Cotton

Always wear thick cotton clothing. Synthetic fabrics catch fire easily and stick to the skin.

🪣

Water Bucket Handy

Always keep a bucket of water or sand nearby to instantly extinguish accidental fires.

🚨

Emergency Protocol

In case of burns, wash immediately with cold water. For any serious injuries, immediately contact medical help.
